# Two runs of one configuration on different hosts: every value except
# times must be bit-identical, and so must every out- key.

exec trainstat repro a.txt b.txt
cmp stdout same.want

# Planted: Train/step=2 grad-norm is one float32 ulp off, and the run
# diverges from there. Repro names step 2, not a later one.
! exec trainstat repro a.txt c.txt
cmp stdout diff.want
stderr 'not bit-identical'

# Runs that differ in pinning keys need not agree: refused, naming each key.
! exec trainstat repro a.txt e.txt
stdout '^cannot compare: device differs \(GB10 vs H100\); exact differs \(true vs false\)$'
! stdout 'bit-identical'
[exec:sh] exec sh -c 'trainstat repro a.txt e.txt; echo status $?'
[exec:sh] stdout '^status 2$'

# -pin replaces the list; key* matches a prefix.
exec trainstat repro -pin commit,lib-* a.txt e.txt
stdout '^config: differs: device "GB10" != "H100"; exact "true" != "false"$'
stdout '^ok: bit-identical$'
! exec trainstat repro -pin 'dev*' a.txt e.txt
stdout '^cannot compare: device differs'

# A configuration difference outside the pinning keys is reported but is
# not a failure.
exec trainstat repro a.txt d.txt
stdout '^config: differs: mode "lora" != "full"$'
stdout '^ok: bit-identical$'

# Each input must be one run.
! exec trainstat repro a.txt $TESTDATA/sweep/base.txt
stderr 'base.txt: more than one run'

ok: bit-identical
-- diff.want --
config: equal (ignored: run, host)
compared bitwise: 3 Train, 1 Final, 1 Run; units loss grad-norm accuracy steps done
skipped kind=time: sec/step train-sec
nondeterministic: same configuration, different results
first difference: Train/step=2 grad-norm 0.625 != 0.62500006 (1 float32 ulp)
differing values: 2 (results: Train 2 of 3)
out-model-sha256: differs
FAIL: not bit-identical
